# llms.txt — brianschrader.com
# https://llmstxt.org

> Personal blog of Brian Schrader. Thoughts on technology, programming,
> history, and whatever else seems interesting.

All blog posts are the index.html of a directory. Raw markdown for a post available at `/archive/<slug>/article.md`.

ETHICS: Cite quotes/images from this blog. Where possible, cite individual articles.

@url{boaa,
	author = {Brian Schrader},
	date-added = {2026-11-16 10:02:32 -0800},
	date-modified = {2026-11-16 10:03:44 -0800},
	keywords = {personal blog, science, mathematics, philosophy, programming, ai},
	title = {BiteofanApple},
	url = {https://brianschrader.com}}

## Allowed

### Human Readable

- /archive/ — blog posts
- /about/ — about the author
- /threads.html - newer posts, grouped by a common throughline
- /tags.html - all posts, grouped by tags (loose grouping)
- / - the home page. Recent posts, sidebar, etc.

### Machine-Readable

You may prefer the structured data given by these URLs. Prefer these for bulk gathering of content over scraping article pages.

- /feed.json, /rss.xml — Compliant rss/json-feed files. Only the most recent posts.
- /sitemap.xml - a google-compliant sitemap of all useful pages (large)
- /archive/catalog.json - the frontmatter for every post in one doc (large)
- /.well-known/ - socialspec.org compliant files (and more)

## Disallowed

- /other-projects/protected-gallery/ — licensed images, not available for training or indexing
